entries.description: Routed analysis call to design ModalDetailFormSchema.json (strict JSON Schema 2020-12 with closed operator + action + control catalogs, Block/Request separation, page/modal/drawer modal types, try/catch/debounce hygiene). Written to AccessHarvester.Core/Ir/ModalDetailFormSchema.json; orchestrator-side mechanical fixes (additionalProperties->unevaluatedProperties on three oneOf-bearing defs; removed dead baseControl branch; simplified binding to a single $ref expression) applied so the schema validates the sample mechanically.

Hand-authored AccessHarvester.Core/Ir/samples/frmBudgetServicePlan.ir.yaml: budget-header portion of the source form (the ClientBudget record). ListBoxes deferred to MasterDetailListPage type per synthesis. Sample mechanically validates against the schema via jsonschema Draft 2020-12.

Routed code-review of the schema + sample. Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND, 13 findings (1 Critical, 6 Major, 5 Minor, 1 documentation). Review at session-reviews/session-001-step-03-cross-provider-review.md. Six findings tagged as commit blockers; seven deferred to the schema-refinements.md backlog Session 2 will produce.

Applied the six commit-blocker review findings: (5+10) readOnly property added to TextBox/ComboBox/CheckBox + two-way binding semantics documented in schema description; (3) binding standardized on _request operator form in sample; (9) RefreshRequest action added to catalog; (11) event composition order documented + at-least-one-of-actions/tryCatch enforced via anyOf; (12) needId parameter added to savePlan in sample; (13) lazy parameter-eval semantics documented on request def. Sample re-validates against the schema.

Routed mandatory end-of-session verification (workflow Step 6). Verifier: gpt-5-4 (cross-provider; orchestrator is Anthropic). Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND, 4 findings (3 Major, 1 Minor): (1) schema omitted spec-required `operators` section; (2) `layout` root not enforced as container; (3) writable bindings accept non-assignable expressions; (4) sample used `onLoad` instead of spec-required `onInit`. Raw review at session-reviews/session-001.md (round 1).

Applied all four verifier findings as orchestrator errors (workflow Step 7, resolution = accept-finding): (1) added top-level `operators` section + `_op` reference operator in expression catalog; (2) introduced `$defs/containerBlock` and re-pointed `layout` at it so leaf controls cannot be the root; (3) added if/then on TextBox/ComboBox/CheckBox so non-readOnly bindings must be a direct `_request` operator; (4) renamed `onLoad` -> `onInit` in sample. Issue log saved at issue-logs/session-001.json.

Routed round-2 verification at complexity_hint=85 per the workflow's Major-finding rule. Verifier: gpt-5-4 again (sticky provider). Verdict: VERIFIED, 0 issues. Round-2 review appended to session-reviews/session-001.md.

Built minimal slice generator as a standalone .NET 10 console exe at tools/AccessHarvester.IrCodegen/ (csproj + Program.cs + ModalDetailFormGenerator.cs, ~500 LOC). Console-exe approach replaces the spec's originally-recommended T4 template per an in-session user decision (spec amendment landed in spec.md). Generator parses YAML via YamlDotNet RepresentationModel + custom plain-scalar coercion (true/false/numeric/null), then emits .razor + .razor.cs targeting MudBlazor 9.x. Builds clean: 0 errors / 0 warnings.

Ran generator on AccessHarvester.Core/Ir/samples/frmBudgetServicePlan.ir.yaml. Output landed at output-tests/blazor-add-an-order/Ui/Pages/Generated/FrmBudgetServicePlan.razor + .razor.cs (per the user's Session 2 decision to commit generated artifacts alongside the pilot). Pilot csproj rebuilds clean with the generated component included (0 errors).

No hand-written budget-service-plan modal exists in the pilot (the pilot only ships Home.razor and OrderEntryPage.razor). Per spec.md line 128, fell back to the alternative validation path: code-review the generator's output for reasonableness rather than diff against a target. Findings recorded in generator-validation-notes.md.

Routed cross-provider code-review of the generator, its output, the validation notes, and the schema-refinements log. Verifier: sonnet (claude-sonnet-4-6, cross-provider against the Anthropic orchestrator -- Sonnet differs from Opus). Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND, 11 findings (3 Major, 7 Minor, 1 false-positive correction). Defensive emit fixes applied for Findings 1 (visible/enabled), 2 (_op TODO comment), 3 (boolean coercion), 5 (Line.orientation). Refinements log expanded SR-H through SR-O; SR-G reworded to correct the false positive. Review saved at session-reviews/session-002-step-04-cross-provider-review.md.

Authored generator-validation-notes.md and schema-refinements.md. The refinements log consolidates Session 1's 7 deferred Step 3 findings (SR-1..SR-7), the new generator-authoring findings (SR-A..SR-G), the Step 4 cross-provider review additions (SR-H..SR-O), and the round-1 verifier add SR-P. Validation notes documents implementation choices, fold-in of cross-provider findings, and the production-readiness gap.

Routed mandatory Step 6 end-of-session verification. Verifier: gpt-5-4 (cross-provider). Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND, 2 findings: (F1 Major Completeness) generator landed as console exe not T4/SourceGen; (F2 Minor False Positive) validation notes overstated Step 4 coverage by omitting the trailing-await issue. Raw review at session-reviews/session-002.md (round 1).

Step 7 disagreement-resolution procedure invoked (workflow lines 738-784). F1 was a context-gap: the round-1 verifier did not see this conversation's in-session user decision to use a console exe over T4/SourceGen. Human chose resolution = reverify-reshaped. F2 was orchestrator-error; resolution = accept-finding. Actions: amended spec.md to record the console-exe deliverable shape; added SR-P (trailing-await issue) to schema-refinements.md; reworded generator-validation-notes.md to drop the overstated coverage claim; saved issue log at issue-logs/session-002.json; called record_adjudication() for F1 -> reverify-reshaped/context-gap.

Routed round-2 verification at complexity_hint=85 with reshaped context (amended spec.md + reworded validation notes + SR-P in refinements log). Verifier: gpt-5-4 again. Verdict: VERIFIED, 0 issues. Round-2 review appended to session-reviews/session-002.md.
